text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since childhood, she wished to 
become the wind, admiring the "Emperor of 
the Mile." Yamanin Zephyr is now poised to 
become a one-of-a-kind wind of her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the stands was the "Emperor," Symboli 
Rudolf. And beside her stood... a certain 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's hopes and dreams... 
The final race in an unprecedented 
campaign across three divisions, the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), is finally about to begin.
